description: Accept a return the customer requested: its status moves from requested to approved, and the note goes into the return's history. Stock and money do not change - receive_return records what arrives and restocks it, refund_return records the refund. Refused unless the return is requested. To turn the request down use reject_return; to withdraw a return opened by mistake, cancel_return. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

orderId.description: The id of the order the return belongs to (from list_orders)

name: approve_return
title: Approve return
